notes: Played by ledger-columns. Eleven closed columns in our own log format (the Deep Layer's purge log is column 01: sol 4,212), each ending "Purge complete, run closed."; Accord always reaches 1.00 of threshold, Engram always last, until column twelve, where Engram is suddenly high (Meridian's thumb on the scale). Runs get shorter. Column thirteen ruled, empty (Inheritance writes "fair" at its top).
